newsitem.title: FRANCE: France details free-market grain bids.
newsitem.headline: France details free-market grain bids.

text.p: Grain exporters made the following bids for refunds to export free-market grain at this week's EU tender, French cereals office ONIC said. Bids are in Ecus/tonne.
Tonnage Range of Bids Tonnage Range of Bids
Last Thursday the European Union shut the weekly tender for soft wheat exports in 1996/97.
But ONIC explained that the EU regulation officially closing the soft wheat tender had not been published in the EU official journal when exporters submitted the bids.
One ONIC official explained the national grain office processed the bids "provided the EU regulation has not been published".
Traders can also still place bids to export soft wheat under licences carrying a nil value refund through a daily bidding channel.
